dateHelp: Enter a valid date through today in YYYY-MM-DD format.
emptyGuardians: Add a guardian to share this clinic record.
guardianHelp: Use the email the guardian verifies on their VetX owner account.
removeConfirm: Remove {name} ({email}) from {patient}’s record? This ends their access at this clinic and cancels their pending code.
issueConfirm: Create a code for {name} ({email}) to link {patient}? This replaces their previous unused code.
expires: Give this code to the guardian. It expires {time}.
emptyOwner: Use the code from your clinic to link your first pet.
whichPet: Which pet is this clinic record for?
verifyEmail: Verify the email your clinic used in Manage account, then sign out and sign back in to use the code.
unavailableCode: This code is unavailable for your account. Check the code and your account email, or ask the clinic for a new code.
invalid: Check the details and try again.
denied: This account no longer has access to this record.
conflict: The record changed or the request conflicts with its current details. Return to the record and review it before trying again.
loadError: The records could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
writeError: The change could not be confirmed. Check your connection and try again.
codeHelp: Enter all 32 characters. You can include spaces or hyphens.
tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait before using a code again.
documentTooLarge: This file exceeds the clinic’s upload limit. Choose a smaller file.
overlap: This patient already has an appointment during that time. Choose a different time and try again.
